CHIEF COMPLAINT: Right ear pain for 2 days.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS: 8-year-old (per parent report) with right ear pain and mild fever, no drainage noted. Recent upper respiratory infection last week.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS: Positive for ear pain and low-grade fever. Negative for hearing loss, drainage.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY: No chronic conditions, no prior ear infections.

VITALS: BP 100/64, HR 92, Temp 99.8F, RR 18.

ASSESSMENT: Acute otitis media, right ear.

PLAN: Amoxicillin 10-day course, acetaminophen for pain/fever, follow up in 2 weeks or sooner if worsening.
